name: Mibu Chigiri
source:
A mysterious freeloader who lives at the Yukimachi mansion.
Everything about him is a mystery. Sometimes he disappears, but there's no sign of him working.

[Translation of [URL=http://stars.ponipa.com/star_pe.html#pe_c]official profile[/URL].]
